name: supabase
description: Comprehensive Supabase backend integration: database queries, Auth identity management, S3-compatible Storage, and Edge Functions.

capabilities.description: Query records from a Supabase Postgres table with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
Insert a new row or batch of rows into a Supabase table.
Update existing records in a Supabase table matching query conditions.
Delete records from a Supabase table matching specific conditions.
Execute a PostgreSQL stored procedure / RPC function on Supabase.
List all Supabase Storage buckets and public access policies.
Upload a file or object into a Supabase Storage bucket.
List registered users and authentication identities via Supabase Admin API.
Trigger a serverless Supabase Edge Function with custom JSON body.
List public tables, views, and schema definitions in the Supabase database.
